chapters.title: Chapter 1801 He turned a normal Law into an Absolute...?
paragraphs: "I still don't see the problem here.
If we already know the solution, why aren't we proceeding?
You should have a way to see my memories, don't you?" Lyriana questioned with a confused frown.
"I remember that Slave Seal magic of yours helps you see memories of your slave, doesn't it?"
Nux stared at the woman in silence.
"What are you waiting for?" Lyriana tilted her head.

"Woman, you do realize what reading your memories entails, do you not? Nux won't just be seeing a part of your memories. A Law is deeply connected to one's being. Even if you think your Law is related to the illusion and the trial you took, that isn't the case. Your Law encompasses your entire being," Shadow warned.
"Yes, I know that." Lyriana nodded.
"From my birth to this moment, he will be seeing all of my memories."
Lyriana then glanced at Nux and,
"You spent quite a lot of time inside the illusion, didn't you? I don't think reading my memories would affect you too much, right?"
Lyriana was worried about an entirely different problem.
Seeing her confused expression, Nux couldn't help but chuckle,
"I'll even see you naked, you know?"
"You d-don't have to focus on that!" Lyriana's face turned red.
"There is no way I can do that. It would be a sight that I will be burning into my
memories."
"Just... focus on comprehending my Law... Read my memories. There might be some... embarrassing moments that I would like to hide, but if that's the only way to get strong, I-I am willing to do it."
Lyriana was prepared to go to any lengths. Of course, the reason why she was so confident was because,
"A-And... if it is you... You can watch it if you want..."
The previous Queen muttered in an extremely low voice.
"Oh? Does this mean you don't mind me seeing you naked?" Nux questioned with a
playful look on his face.
"N-Not that!" Lyriana shouted.

"I... I know what you are worried about... And I am telling you that you don't have to think too much. When I left Yrniel with you, I was prepared to sacrifice everything I have in order to gain power. Letting you read my memories doesn't affect me. I have nothing to hide."
Lyriana declared, her eyes brimming with determination.
Nux smiled, then he nodded, mirroring her determination.
"Let's start then. Thankfully, I just learned something interesting a few hours ago, so there is no need to use Slave Seal here."

Saying those words, Nux placed his hand on Lyriana's head and closed his eyes. The Aetherialis bloodline that allows him to absorb knowledge was activated, and in an instant, his energy entered Lyriana's body.
"Don't resist."
He spoke. Lyriana nodded, letting her guard down and allowing Nux's energy to flow into her body without any form of resistance.
Soon, Nux started seeing her memories.

Lyriana, as a Divine Stage Cultivator, had thousands of years of memories inside her head. This, combined with the illusion she went in and the trial she took, meant there were around 8,000 years of memories Nux had to see and comprehend.
A number that now seemed... quite small.

The Aetherialis bloodline, now strengthened, worked wonders. In an hour, Nux saw all of Lyriana's memories, not leaving even any part. Right now, he probably knew more about the previous Elven Queen than she did herself.
"D-Did it work?"
Lyriana, who felt Nux's energy leaving her body, opened her eyes and questioned with an unsure look on her face.
Nux stared at the woman standing in front of him with a new understanding. For now, however, he didn't waste any time and comprehended her Law from her memories.
Law of Frostbound Liberation.
"Form your Law again," Nux ordered.
Lyriana nodded and closed her eyes.
Her Aura burst out, and suddenly, a form of energy that only Nux could see released from her body and rushed toward him. Nux didn't resist and allowed the energy to surround him.
It was a familiar energy, an energy he had comprehended just now. It didn't take long for Nux to be able to take control over this energy.
He moved the energy around his body for a while. Lyriana's body continued to release more and more of this energy. All this energy rushed toward Nux, and he continued to gather it around him.

Soon, he started releasing a similar type of energy. His energy mixed together with Lyriana's, and as if affected by his energy, Lyriana's energy started metamorphosizing. Lyriana didn't seem to notice this. She continued to release more and more energy, and Nux continued to gather and strengthen her energy.
*Lyriana's picture* (AN: It's so perfect that I didn't change anything.)

Finally, once Lyriana stopped releasing the energy, the massive whirlpool of energy that Nux had gathered, which was twice the size of what it should have been since Nux added his own energy into the mix, began to stabilize.
Once Nux was satisfied, he nodded. In an instant, the energy moved toward Lyriana
and rushed into her body.
BOOOOM
An explosion was heard, and the next instant, everything around Lyriana-Air, Space, the Death Energy from Necrocore-turned into frost.

The previous Elven Queen now looked like the Queen of Frost floating in the air. A crown made of crystalline ice adorned her head, her hair became longer, her skin clearer. All of this, combined with her usual expressionless face, made it feel like the
woman had gone through a rebirth.
Finally, the woman opened her eyes. Her crystal blue irises glimmered with almost endless power. Even Felberta, Amaya, and Riona, for some reason, felt intimidated by
her power.
Soon, however, a slight frown appeared on Lyriana's beautiful face.
"This... isn't my Law..." she muttered with a frown.
"It is your Law," Nux replied with a smile.
Lyriana, who understood that Nux was the one who did it, was surprised.
"How did you do it?" she questioned.
"What did he do?" Felberta questioned with a curious look on her face.
"He turned my normal Law into an Absolute...
The Law I was supposed to form was the Law of Frostbound Liberation.
But what I formed was the Law of Absolute Frostbound Liberation."
Lyriana revealed, and the other women blinked in surprise.
"He turned a normal Law into an Absolute...?" While the other women were shocked by this news,
Shadow suddenly called out, her tone full of disbelief. "Do you feel it as well...?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1802 A Way to Get Stronger.
paragraphs: Shadow suddenly called out, her tone full of disbelief.
"Do you feel it as well...?"
Nux was silent.
Seeing that, the women, including Lyriana, frowned and appeared next to him.
"What happened?"
Amaya questioned with a worried look on her face.
Nux was still in shock, so much so that he couldn't even speak.
"You what...?"
Felberta frowned.
Lyriana, on the other hand, had a worried look on her face.
"I got stronger..."
"Huh?"
The women blinked in surprise.
"Stronger?"
"Yes. If at first, I was an Initial Level Divine Stage Cultivator, now I am stronger." Nux nodded.
The women frowned in confusion, and Nux simplified his words,
"Like in the System's terms, if before, I was a Level 160 Cultivator who had just become

a Divine Stage Cultivator, now, my cultivation has progressed, and I have become Level 163 or 164. I have grown stronger. The 'quality of my energy' has become stronger, and if I am not wrong, then..."
Nux glanced at Shadow and,
"As the 'Soul of my Universe, Shadow must have gotten stronger with me as well." "Of course, I did.
My connection to you is the strongest, after all."
Shadow purposefully glanced at Amaya as she said those words. The devourer's mouth twitched without stop.
For now, however, she had more important things to focus on.
"How did you get stronger?"
It was a problem Nux had been facing for a while now.
Through his memories, he knew how he was supposed to progress further in his cultivation, all the way to the Eternal Level, actually. However... that was only the case if he was a normal entity.
And he was far from normal.
He was an entirely different Universe, and the worst part was that he had no clue how he was supposed to grow further.

Yes, even though he was strong enough to pretty much ignore Divine Stage Beings even if they came from a Supreme World, even though he was strong enough to take on Primordials, in the end, Nux was only a Level 160 Divine Stage Cultivator, someone who had just broken through the Saint Stage.
Now, however, that had finally changed.
He had gotten stronger. He had finally grown, and now, Amaya needed to understand why this happened so she could somehow come up with a way to help Nux get even stronger.
And Shadow already knew the reason.
"He did what he is supposed to."
The women turned towards her, and Shadow started explaining.
"He acknowledged an entity's Law and allowed her to become a Divine Stage Cultivator. He fulfilled his role as a Universe. This is how he got stronger."
The women turned towards Nux, and he nodded.
Just like Shadow, he felt it as well.

It happened before as well. He became a Divine Stage Cultivator because he acknowledged his own existence. That was his first step in becoming a Universe, and now, as he got closer to acting more and more like a Universe, he got stronger again.
"So you will continue to get stronger as you accept more and more people and acknowledge their Laws?"
Amaya questioned, and Nux nodded.
"So if you devour all our cultivations and acknowledge our Laws, you will get even
stronger?"
"That won't work."
Nux shook his head.
at least not now."
"So to get stronger, you need to form connections with more people and help them form their Laws and become Divine Stage Cultivators?"
"For me, that would be similar to cultivating, yes."
"If you became Level 163 just with Lyriana alone, considering Primordial is Level 180, you would only need seven more to become a Primordial..."
Soon, however, Amaya's expression changed.
"But I guess it won't be that easy, would it?"
Nux smiled as he shook his head,
"It won't."
"At the very least, we now have a way."
Amaya shrugged.
"I guess participating in the War and devouring more Worlds became even more important now, huh...

Devouring Umbrasol allowed you to devour 128 more people, and you have already devoured 12. In the worst-case scenario, even if you use up all that space, you might not be able to break through the Primordial Stage, so we need to participate in the War and get more Space."
Felberta spoke with a serious look on her face, and Lyriana, who stood next to them, nodded. This time, there was a confident look on her face.
After all, she could feel it.
Her strength...
It had reached a level she could have never imagined before.
Right now, what she wanted the most was to go fight and go all out against her opponent to test her limit, and she already had a perfect candidate in her mind.
"We will do all that, yes."

Nux nodded, then his eyes glimmered brightly as suddenly, he turned towards Shadow, and the woman, who instantly understood what he wanted, expanded her shadow and pulled every single one of them into Nux's Universe.
"First, I need to clear this mess."
The moment the women materialized in Nux's Universe, they heard his voice echo
throughout the space.
They looked around, trying to find him, but they couldn't.
"What are you trying to do?"
Amaya questioned.
"Right now, this place looks like everything was just thrown here randomly. There is
no structure, all the energies just... exist, and now, I need to clean it.
I need to create a functioning Universe."
"But.... didn't you say all the Primordial Energies are required for the Universe to be
able to function automatically?"
Amaya questioned with a doubtful look on her face.
"Yes, all of those energies are required for a Universe to function, a normal Universe,
that is."
Amaya tilted her head, and Nux's smile widened.
"I am different.𝓯𝙧𝙚𝒆𝙬𝙚𝒃𝙣𝙤𝒗𝓮𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
Unlike a normal Universe,
I am conscious. I can control things a normal Universe cannot.
The Primordial Energies need to be in a perfect balance to be able to function together automatically, and usually, that balance can only be achieved when all the
Primordial Energies are present.
But...
I will just use my will to force that balance onto the Primordial Energies we have here.
I will create a functioning Universe with whatever I have,
And I will begin this...
Today!"
Nux's voice echoed throughout the Universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1803 Forcefully Established Balance
paragraphs: RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
Nux's Universe shook.
Amaya, Lane, Shadow, Felberta, and Lyriana, everyone seeing this grand sight could feel their bodies tremble.
This Universe, which was just a vast space that stretched endlessly with different energies and worlds randomly put together, was now going through a change.
All the energies that were spread all over the wide Universe started gathering around, literal Worlds had started moving.
Nux's first focus was Umbrasol.
"This will be the main World where all of us would reside."
His words echoed through the space. The women who were just floating in the void could see the massive world being separated from the rest.
It was fixed at the very middle of the Universe, and the huge whirlpools of energies that were formed started moving towards it.
"Now, I will create a new balance between the energies I have here."
Nux's voice echoed again as one by one, all the energies started surrounding the massive Umbrasol.
"Energy of Genesis."
Nux spoke, and the white cloud-like mist moved, surrounding Umbrasol, but it wasn't alone,
"Energy of Destruction."
It came together with the Energy that balanced it, the Energy of Destruction.
"Energy of Life."
The energies that belonged to Shadow and Evane rushed in, accompanied by another energy,
"Energy of Death."
The Energy that came from the Law of Absolute Death.

Yes, because of the strength of this Law, the Energy of Death was much stronger than the others, and that itself would cause the balance to tilt, but Nux simply used his will to suppress the Death Energy.
Sure, this energy was strong and dominating, but in here, Nux's Will was the only Absolute-nothing else mattered.
The four Primordial Energies worked together, forming a strange balance.
Nux waited. The true balance still wasn't achieved. Just these few energies could not co-exist together, so he knew something would happen, and just as he expected, it did.
Within a few hours, the 'Balance' created started deforming. There were too many factors affecting it, and Nux couldn't solve those issues separately.
Therefore, Nux decided to reform the balance from scratch.
Then, he waited, and once again, within a few hours, the balance was disrupted. "24 hours..."
Nux muttered as he reformed the balance again.
"Shadow."
He called out.
Shadow, who stood next to the others, nodded as she flew up.
"I know."
She muttered as she took control over these energies and connected her consciousness with them.
"I need to reform this balance every 24 hours, correct?"
"...I apologize for lea-"
"Nux."
Shadow called out.
"There is no need to apologize.
As the Absolute Goddess of this Universe and its Heart, it is my duty to maintain it."
The entity then glanced at the rest of the women, especially Amaya and,
"Others may be close to your outside body, but in the end, only I have all the access to your 'real' body, so I need to take the responsibility, no?"
Amaya stared at the woman with a dangerous look on her face. Shadow, however, completely ignored the woman and flew above,
Taking control of the four energies that were in temporary balance.
"Now,"
Nux's voice was heard as once again, the rest of the Universe other than Umbrasol shook.
The Sapling that represented the Law of Absolute Growth moved, implanting itself at the very center of Umbrasol.
"The Energy of Growth."
Nux's voice echoed.
After the Sapling of Growth, it was the Lotus of Life that planted itself at the completely opposite end of Umbrasol.
Now, with the Energy of Growth in the mix, instead of four, the Balance was formed between five Energies.
The instability created by the addition of another energy made it so that the balance would be disrupted every 12 hours instead of 24.
Shadow didn't mind; rather, she was glad Nux was relying on her. Not to mention,
watching Amaya's expressions below was extremely fun.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
While the women played their own game, Nux continued.
Umbrasol and the five energies were all put in balance. Now, what was left were the
other worlds and Worlds.
Nux's next focus was on the two lowest-level worlds that he had devoured before. The
two worlds moved out of the energies' influence. was as if they were being
disregarded from the Universe.
"These will be Stars."
Nux's dismissive voice echoed.
Yes, he was using two worlds as mere stars that would store all other Laws he had
learned.
Of course, the 'Space' he was using to store these Laws still belonged to Umbrasol. However, none of those energies disturbed Umbrasol's Balance.
Why? Because Nux willed it so.
"It's a success."
Shadow smiled.
"What do you mean?"
Felberta questioned as she flew next to her along with the others.
"I got stronger again."
Shadow replied.
"Mhm."
Shadow nodded.
"So if you got stronger..."
"That means Nux got stronger as well. By making his Universe partially functional, he,
as a Universe, got stronger than before.
If I am not wrong, new life forms that belong to just this Universe alone should be
born soon."
"What?"
The women blinked in surprise.
"Well, of course, those life forms would be extremely simple creatures, probably even
faulty since we do not have all the Primordial Energies yet, but it would still be
progress."
"Wait..."
Suddenly, Amaya called out.
"If this Universe can have its own life forms, wouldn't it be faster if these life forms
cultivate and get stronger on their own?
After all, there is a limit to how many people can we bring and sever their connections with the main Universe. If we can create those people here...
Even if we take a High Level World like Umbrasol as an example, we can have millions
of Divine Stage Cultivators. With all those cultivators strengthening Nux...
He might even break through the Primordial Stage and become a Transcendent."
A Transcendent Level Nux...
Just thinking about what sort of nightmare that being would be for the rest of the
Universe made the women smile in anticipation.
"What do you think he is doing right now?"
Shadow questioned with a smile.
"Hmm?"
Felberta tilted her head.
"A Cultivation Bridge..."
Amaya muttered.
Shadow turned towards her, slightly surprised.
"He already knows about Umbrasol's Cultivation Bridge, and the Umbrasol
Progenitors also explored how other Worlds' Cultivation Bridges worked. With everything they knew now in his head,
He could easily form a strong Cultivation Bridge that would allow entities of his
Universe to grow without being restricted."
Amaya muttered, and as if to confirm those words,
Evane's voice was heard,

sentences.text: RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
Nux's Universe shook.
Amaya, Lane, Shadow, Felberta, and Lyriana, everyone seeing this grand sight could feel their bodies tremble.
This Universe, which was just a vast space that stretched endlessly with different energies and worlds randomly put together, was now going through a change.
All the energies that were spread all over the wide Universe started gathering around, literal Worlds had started moving.
Nux's first focus was Umbrasol.
"This will be the main World where all of us would reside."
His words echoed through the space.
The women who were just floating in the void could see the massive world being separated from the rest.
It was fixed at the very middle of the Universe, and the huge whirlpools of energies that were formed started moving towards it.
"Now, I will create a new balance between the energies I have here."
Nux's voice echoed again as one by one, all the energies started surrounding the massive Umbrasol.
"Energy of Genesis."
Nux spoke, and the white cloud-like mist moved, surrounding Umbrasol, but it wasn't alone,
"Energy of Destruction."
It came together with the Energy that balanced it, the Energy of Destruction.
"Energy of Life."
The energies that belonged to Shadow and Evane rushed in, accompanied by another energy,
"Energy of Death."
The Energy that came from the Law of Absolute Death.

Yes, because of the strength of this Law, the Energy of Death was much stronger than the others, and that itself would cause the balance to tilt, but Nux simply used his will to suppress the Death Energy.
Sure, this energy was strong and dominating, but in here, Nux's Will was the only Absolute-nothing else mattered.
The four Primordial Energies worked together, forming a strange balance.
Nux waited.
The true balance still wasn't achieved.
Just these few energies could not co-exist together, so he knew something would happen, and just as he expected, it did.
Within a few hours, the 'Balance' created started deforming.
There were too many factors affecting it, and Nux couldn't solve those issues separately.
Therefore, Nux decided to reform the balance from scratch.
Then, he waited, and once again, within a few hours, the balance was disrupted.
"24 hours..."
Nux muttered as he reformed the balance again.
"Shadow."
He called out.
Shadow, who stood next to the others, nodded as she flew up.
"I know."
She muttered as she took control over these energies and connected her consciousness with them.
"I need to reform this balance every 24 hours, correct?"
"...I apologize for lea-"
"Nux."
Shadow called out.
"There is no need to apologize.
As the Absolute Goddess of this Universe and its Heart, it is my duty to maintain it."
The entity then glanced at the rest of the women, especially Amaya and,
"Others may be close to your outside body, but in the end, only I have all the access to your 'real' body, so I need to take the responsibility, no?"
Amaya stared at the woman with a dangerous look on her face.
Shadow, however, completely ignored the woman and flew above,
Taking control of the four energies that were in temporary balance.
"Now,"
Nux's voice was heard as once again, the rest of the Universe other than Umbrasol shook.
The Sapling that represented the Law of Absolute Growth moved, implanting itself at the very center of Umbrasol.
"The Energy of Growth."
Nux's voice echoed.
After the Sapling of Growth, it was the Lotus of Life that planted itself at the completely opposite end of Umbrasol.
Now, with the Energy of Growth in the mix, instead of four, the Balance was formed between five Energies.
The instability created by the addition of another energy made it so that the balance would be disrupted every 12 hours instead of 24.
Shadow didn't mind; rather, she was glad Nux was relying on her.
Not to mention,
watching Amaya's expressions below was extremely fun.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
While the women played their own game, Nux continued.
Umbrasol and the five energies were all put in balance.
Now, what was left were the
other worlds and Worlds.
Nux's next focus was on the two lowest-level worlds that he had devoured before.
The
two worlds moved out of the energies' influence. was as if they were being
disregarded from the Universe.
"These will be Stars."
Nux's dismissive voice echoed.
Yes, he was using two worlds as mere stars that would store all other Laws he had
learned.
Of course, the 'Space' he was using to store these Laws still belonged to Umbrasol.
However, none of those energies disturbed Umbrasol's Balance.
Why?
Because Nux willed it so.
"It's a success."
Shadow smiled.
"What do you mean?"
Felberta questioned as she flew next to her along with the others.
"I got stronger again."
Shadow replied.
"Mhm."
Shadow nodded.
"So if you got stronger..."
"That means Nux got stronger as well.
By making his Universe partially functional, he,
as a Universe, got stronger than before.
If I am not wrong, new life forms that belong to just this Universe alone should be
born soon."
"What?"
The women blinked in surprise.
"Well, of course, those life forms would be extremely simple creatures, probably even
faulty since we do not have all the Primordial Energies yet, but it would still be
progress."
"Wait..."
Suddenly, Amaya called out.
"If this Universe can have its own life forms, wouldn't it be faster if these life forms
cultivate and get stronger on their own?
After all, there is a limit to how many people can we bring and sever their connections with the main Universe.
If we can create those people here...
Even if we take a High Level World like Umbrasol as an example, we can have millions
of Divine Stage Cultivators.
With all those cultivators strengthening Nux...
He might even break through the Primordial Stage and become a Transcendent."
A Transcendent Level Nux...
Just thinking about what sort of nightmare that being would be for the rest of the
Universe made the women smile in anticipation.
"What do you think he is doing right now?"
Shadow questioned with a smile.
"Hmm?"
Felberta tilted her head.
"A Cultivation Bridge..."
Amaya muttered.
Shadow turned towards her, slightly surprised.
"He already knows about Umbrasol's Cultivation Bridge, and the Umbrasol
Progenitors also explored how other Worlds' Cultivation Bridges worked.
With everything they knew now in his head,
He could easily form a strong Cultivation Bridge that would allow entities of his
Universe to grow without being restricted."

Evane's voice was heard,

chapters.title: Chapter 1804 She really did it, huh...
paragraphs: 'Nux...
I have news...'
Evane's voice was heard.
The woman focused on her words, but before the Elf could continue,
"I know."
Nux spoke as he materialized in front of his wives with a big smile on his face. A smile that instantly attracted the women's attention.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
"I should have done this sooner."
Nux spoke, the grin on his face widening even further.
Then, he moved out of his Universe, and the very fact that he didn't ask Shadow to do that for him showed that he had lost his calm and couldn't control his emotions.
What could possibly make him act like this?
The women didn't have to think.
'Evane!
Felberta called out, and the Elf nodded,
'She's awake!
The women then glanced at each other, and before they could say anything, Shadow sent all of them outside to where Nux was.

After Nux, the women materialized in front of an old cottage. It was the cottage that belonged to Sylvara Origin, one of the Six Elven Progenitors. It was usually a secluded place where Sylvara rested without anyone bothering her,
Right now, however, this place was filled with visitors.
Nux and all of his wives except for Lane were here. Even Astaria, who had gone out, had returned to see her master and sister.
Both Dragon Progenitors, Dagahra and Saphira, Faustina, Caesar, Lilith, and a few other Progenitors were here as well.
Not just them, even the strongest of them all, Azriel Ruinous, was here as well.
Of course, the Vampire didn't really care about whatever was happening, he was just here because his daughter was here.
Yes, even though she was embarrassed and her mind still couldn't get rid of the images of her and Nux being so close and drinking each other's blood, she still came
here. After all, she couldn't miss this moment.
When Amaya, Felberta, Lyriana, and Riona saw this scene, they were surprised. They glanced at Nux and saw him staring at the cottage with a wide grin on his face.
Then suddenly, Nux moved his right leg forward and lowered his body, taking his battle stance.
The others around him frowned, but before they could react, Nux used [Absolute Kinesis] to move them away, and as he did,
BOOM
What seemed like a golden-red missile launched itself towards him, completely destroying the cottage she was in, and she collided with Nux,
BOO000000OOM
Another explosion was heard as the people around them were pushed back even further.
Nux's grin widened,
"Still not enough, huh...?"
"Are you challenging me in a battle of strength?"
Nux chuckled.
"Don't act like I don't see that."

The Dragon spoke as she glanced at the ground beneath Nux's feet. It had shifted. Yes, Nux was pushed back, even if it was just a few centimeters, he was still pushed back. Not just that, Nux's arms, which he had used to block the woman's punch, were broken and were trembling nonstop.
"She really did it, huh..."
Amaya commented...
She was in disbelief till now, but now that she was seeing it with her own eyes, she had no doubts.
"A Primordial."
"She managed to break through...
And to think she did it the instant Nux formed the Cultivation Bridge.
So this is what was her back all this time, huh?"
Felberta wondered.
"Wait.... does this make her the first woman to walk on the Cultivation Bridge Nux formed?"
Amaya narrowed her eyes when she heard those words.
Yes, it went without saying, she was jealous.
'I need to break through!
This gave her a new form of motivation; she couldn't lose to these bitches.
"You have gotten stronger, much stronger than before."
Nux spoke with his smile as his broken arms healed. It didn't take long since Vyriana quickly removed her energy from his body.
"Congratulations, you finally did it."

Nux spoke as he extended his hands. The Dragon quickly placed her head on his chest and covered herself with Nux's endless warmth. In an instant, she gave away all the control over her body to the man in front of her, allowing him to do whatever he
wanted.
Nux wrapped his arms around his Dragon and kissed her forehead, trying to overwhelm her with his love. Vyriana's body trembled, receiving all his love as she
closed her eyes.
"I can't believe it...
Did you feel that Aura...?"
One of the Elven Progenitors questioned as he turned towards a Demon Progenitor.
"I have never seen a Primordial release such pressure..."
Of course, when he said a Primordial, he never considered Aeliana.
The Progenitors had long stopped considering the father and daughter normal entities. They were exceptions. Right now, however, the Aura this woman released was
close to the level of being these 'exceptions.'
"What can I say...?
As expected of her? I mean, there is a reason both Dagahra and Saphira decided to choose her. She was exceptional from the very beginning."
One of the Progenitors added.
But then...
"You talk about her, but...
Did any of you not see that monster blocked her punch and managed to hold his
"His arms were shattered."
"Your point? Doesn't make him any less monstrous; he blocked a Primordial's attack
without any trickery."
Soon, the Progenitors' focus shifted to Nux.
However, for the ones who were already familiar with him, like Aeliana, they simply
ignored what he did and walked towards her friend,
"You finally broke through; took you long enough."
The Vampire smiled, then, as if her competitive side had awakened,
"Want to spar?"
"I don't."
Vyriana shook her head.
Not just. Aeliana, but the rest of the people who knew Vyriana were shocked at her
words.

Was this the same woman who challenged almost every Divine Stage Cultivator the moment she broke through? Even if she didn't win, she would continue to challenge Divines like a madwoman and only stopped once she had defeated all Divines and had
no competition left.
There was a reason why Vyriana was so feared in the Order; the woman had beaten up
all the Divines there were. Heck, she had even challenged Primordials but couldn't
hold against them.
To think she, of all people, would deny a challenge...
It was shocking.
Vyriana, however, turned towards Nux and,
"You didn't kill him, did you?"
She questioned.
"Did you think I would?"
Nux questioned back with a smile.
"I love you."
Vyriana's smile widened as she sealed her husband's lips.
"I love you more~"
Nux chuckled, then suddenly, he opened a portal.
"Shall we?"
He questioned.
A determined look appeared on the Dragon's face, and she nodded.
"Let's go."
Their next destination?
The Core where Zyros was imprisoned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1805 Complete Hopelessness.
paragraphs: "What just happened...?"
"Where did she go...?"
The Progenitors questioned as they turned towards Nux's wives for answers.
"To the man who put her in that state."
Astaria shrugged.
"What...?"
Dagahra tilted his head, the temperature around him fell as his eyes turned cold. Saphira's expression was similar.
It was quite an intimidating scene to look at, Astaria, however, just shrugged and,
"The man who attacked her and put her in that state, Nux knew she would want to see him when she wakes up, so instead of killing him, he captured him instead."
The Sword Girl explained.
"Wait, wait, wait."
Saphira shook her head.
"I was told that it was a Primordial who attacked her."
"Yes, and?"
Astaria tilted her head as she stared at the Dragon Progenitor,
Saphira's frown deepened, she turned towards Sylvara, who knew more about the situation, and the Elven Progenitor nodded with a wry smile on her face.
Saphira understood what that smile meant.
'She is telling the truth...'
It wasn't just the Dragon Progenitor; the rest of the Progenitors who didn't know much about the situation widened their eyes in disbelief.
The Progenitors weren't fools, they could tell what this meant.
"So instead of running away... that man faced a Primordial and captured him alive...?"
Dagahra couldn't hold himself back and questioned with a shocked look on his face. "Five of them, actually."
Allura chuckled playfully when she said those words. Aisha understood what her sister was trying to do, so she jumped in as well.
"Well, there were around 30 Complete Divines as well, but I guess they don't really matter at this point, do they?"
Allura's smile widened when she saw Aisha understood what she wanted, so she continued,
"Right, they barely did anything anyways."
"Nux did want to capture a few of them though..."
"Tsk, can't believe they just died just from the aftereffects of the battle, couldn't even survive before Nux could capture them."
The more the women talked, the weirder the atmosphere got.
It didn't take long for the rest of the women to join in the conversation as well.
The Progenitors stared at them in disbelief.
"A-Are they bluffing...?"
One of them couldn't help but question. All of this was simply too unbelievable.
Even Sylvara, who had heard the entire story from Evane before, had a doubtful look on her face now.
"They are not."
Azriel, however, shook his head.
The Progenitors all turned towards him and,𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝕨𝕖𝗯𝚗𝚘𝕧𝕖𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝕞
"Don't underestimate that child.
He is training with Lia, and he is forcing her to use quite a bit of her strength."
"He is forcing A-Aeliana to use most of her strength?"
The Progenitors were in disbelief.
"At his current strength, he can probably take on all of Yrniel's Primordials at the same time."
Azriel commented.
The Progenitors turned towards Aeliana, wanting to confirm those words. Aeliana, however, was thinking about an entirely different matter.
"He knew she would want to get revenge the moment she wakes up, so he captured him instead of killing him..."
She muttered, her face red, her thoughts running wild.
The women who saw the looks on her face smiled. Allura, of course, couldn't hold herself back and walked towards the Vampire.
"Sister Aeliana~"
She called out.
The Vampire turned towards her and Allura's smile widened.
"I heard something quite interesting happened between you and Nux, mind telling me what it was?"
In an instant, Aeliana's face turned red.
The instant the rest of the women saw her expression, their smiles widened as well, and they surrounded the poor Vampire.
Azriel, seeing the flustered look on her daughter's face, wanted to save her, but there was nothing he could do.
Nux and Vyriana stepped inside Core.
"Where is he?"
Vyriana questioned.
Nux smiled as he then took her inside their mansion's basement. In there, inside a cell, Vyriana's eyes fell on an unconscious body that was bound by cold iron chains.
"Why does he look... like that?"

Zyros's body was no longer pulsing with the radiant hues of blue light. It now appeared dull and lifeless. His eyes were dark and sunken, looking like hollow, shadowy orbs. His core that once shimmered with bright blue energy had become hollow as well.
It looked like all of his energy had been sucked out of it. He looked brittle and weak, unlike a fearsome entity before, he now looked like a cluster of withered vines grouped together.

Of course, Vyriana knew she wouldn't find the man in one piece, especially when she was hurt and didn't wake up for such a long time. She had seen the crazed, desperate, and horrified look on Nux's face when he realized that the attack was targeted at her. That little moment was enough for her to know that Zyros's future days were anything
but peaceful.
But this...?
Even Vyriana was taken aback by his current condition.
Hearing her question, Nux's eyes shined with a cold glint. Soon, however, he glanced
at the ceiling and saw Zyros's soul floating above.
He was expressionless, despite being fully conscious. He didn't react even though Nux
had appeared in front of him.
Why?
Had he overcome his fear?
No, completely opposite of that, in fact.
Zyros was broken. In these past few years, he had gone through so much agonizing pain, that too, without a single break, that his very will to live or even die had been
erased.
He had gone through so much pain that his very emotions were erased.
For Nux, this was a common sight. It was similar to how the Souls the Umbrasol Progenitors experimented on gave in to their fate.
This was how complete hopelessness looked like.
Nux was familiar with this sight, Vyriana, however, was not.
"W-What is that?"
The Dragon was in disbelief.
"His Soul."
Nux answered calmly.
"No, even if that is his soul...
Why...
What are those pins inside his soul...?
Wait... how many are there...?
Ten... no...
Hundred thousand...?"
Yes, that agonizing pain that crushed Zyros to his core and filled him with endless
fear,
Nux made him go through that pain more than a hundred thousand times.

The Vampire turned towards her and Allura's smile widened.
"I heard something quite interesting happened between you and Nux, mind telling me what it was?"
In an instant, Aeliana's face turned red.
The instant the rest of the women saw her expression, their smiles widened as well, and they surrounded the poor Vampire.
Azriel, seeing the flustered look on her daughter's face, wanted to save her, but there was nothing he could do.
Nux and Vyriana stepped inside Core.
"Where is he?"
Vyriana questioned.
Nux smiled as he then took her inside their mansion's basement.
In there, inside a cell, Vyriana's eyes fell on an unconscious body that was bound by cold iron chains.
"Why does he look... like that?"
Zyros's body was no longer pulsing with the radiant hues of blue light.
It now appeared dull and lifeless.
His eyes were dark and sunken, looking like hollow, shadowy orbs.
His core that once shimmered with bright blue energy had become hollow as well.
It looked like all of his energy had been sucked out of it.
He looked brittle and weak, unlike a fearsome entity before, he now looked like a cluster of withered vines grouped together.
Of course, Vyriana knew she wouldn't find the man in one piece, especially when she was hurt and didn't wake up for such a long time.
She had seen the crazed, desperate, and horrified look on Nux's face when he realized that the attack was targeted at her.
That little moment was enough for her to know that Zyros's future days were anything
but peaceful.
But this...?
Even Vyriana was taken aback by his current condition.
Hearing her question, Nux's eyes shined with a cold glint.
Soon, however, he glanced
at the ceiling and saw Zyros's soul floating above.
He was expressionless, despite being fully conscious.
He didn't react even though Nux
had appeared in front of him.
Why?
Had he overcome his fear?
No, completely opposite of that, in fact.
Zyros was broken.
In these past few years, he had gone through so much agonizing pain, that too, without a single break, that his very will to live or even die had been
erased.
He had gone through so much pain that his very emotions were erased.
For Nux, this was a common sight.
It was similar to how the Souls the Umbrasol Progenitors experimented on gave in to their fate.
This was how complete hopelessness looked like.
Nux was familiar with this sight, Vyriana, however, was not.
"W-What is that?"
The Dragon was in disbelief.
"His Soul."
Nux answered calmly.
"No, even if that is his soul...
Why...
What are those pins inside his soul...?
Wait... how many are there...?
Ten... no...
Hundred thousand...?"
Yes, that agonizing pain that crushed Zyros to his core and filled him with endless
fear,
Nux made him go through that pain more than a hundred thousand times.

chapters.title: Chapter 1806 If you win, I will kill you.
paragraphs: "No, even if that is his soul....
Why...
What are those pins inside his soul...?
Wait... how many are there...?
Ten... no....
Hundred thousand...?"
"He deserved it."
Nux just shrugged.
Then, he glanced at Zyros's soul and,
"Oi."
He called out.
Zyros, however, completely ignored his words, or maybe it was better to say that he was in no state to reply to Nux.
Nux, however, had a way to make him respond.
"I can kill you for good if you listen and do what I say,"
The instant he said those words, Zyros's soul flinched, and he turned towards Nux.
The word he heard wasn't 'kill.'
It was freedom.
Yes, Freedom.
The Ultimate Release.
A Way to End this Nightmare.
Yes, to Zyros, this was the greatest reward he had received in his entire life.
"...w-what do I n-need to do?"
He questioned, his voice barely coming out of his throat. He was in no condition to speak. It was as if he had forgotten how to speak, and his soul was recalling that feeling right now.
"Fight her."
Nux pointed at Vyriana.
"If you win, I will kill you.
If you lose, you will return to this place."
Zyros's eyes fell on Vyriana, and his soul trembled.
How could he forget who this woman was?
Even if he forgets his own family, he would never forget this woman.
After all, she was the reason he was trapped in this horrifying nightmare in the first place.
Even now, he regretted and cursed his past self for attacking her.
Fight this woman and hurt her again?
There is no way he would do that.
Even if he wanted to, his consciousness would never allow him to, and Nux, who was observing his face, narrowed his eyes.
"You are in this state because you sneak-attacked her. It wouldn't be the same if you had hurt her in a fair and square battle."
Nux spoke with a cold look on his face.
Zyros, of course, didn't say anything.
Even in his wildest dreams, he would never think of refuting this man's words.

"Now, are you willing to fight her or not? Let me make this clear right here and now, this will be your only chance to get away from this hell. If you don't accept, don't think you will be getting any rest."
Zyros accepted.
Nux nodded. He then covered his hand with Death Energy and extended it towards Zyros's soul. Once again, his soul flinched. He wanted to move away out
he forced his body to stay.
He didn't wish to offend Nux in any way.
Vyriana, who was seeing everything, was taken aback.
'Just what did he do...?"
She wondered in her head.
instinct, but
Nux, on the other hand, grabbed Zyros's head. His Death Energy penetrated his body,
and the next instant, all the pins inside Zyros's soul fell out.
"Make sure you win, or all these pins will be injected into your soul again."
Nux's threatening voice was heard.
Zyros nodded desperately. The last thing he wanted was that nightmare to repeat itself.
Nux then grabbed Zyros's soul and put him back inside his body.
The process wasn't long. It barely took 3 minutes, and finally, Zyros's withered body
seemed to come back to life.
His dark hollow eyeball turned blue, his Core and veins all lit up as well, and when Nux broke the chains binding his body, he stood up.
His movements were extremely slow, his balance was off. It was clear that he wasn't used
to his body anymore.
Nux, however, didn't care.
He simply glanced at Zyros and then Vyriana.
"Let's move."
Nux smiled.
Vyriana nodded. She was worried that Zyros would try to run away, especially after she
saw his state. Her worries, however, were unfounded.
Let alone trying to run, Zyros made sure not to make even a single move that would put
him in Nux's bad books.
He was like a well-tamed dog.
Even people under the effect of the Slave Seal didn't act this way.
Nux then waved his hand and activated teleportation, instantly moving the two to the
place he was training together with Acliana.
Vyriana and Zyros looked around.
"So the rules are simple.
There are no rules.
The one who gives up or is in no state to fight anymore loses. Killing is allowed, weapons
are allowed, any form of tactics or trickery is allowed.
If Zyros wins, he will be killed. If he loses, I will sever his soul again.
Is that clear?"
Vyriana simply nodded as she stared at the man in front of her.
Honestly, she was disappointed. She could see Zyros was in no condition to fight her.
The one she wanted to fight was the man who had attacked her and was prepared to kill her and her husband, but the one in front of her...
He was a broken will whose motivation to fight this battle was so that he could get killed and end his nightmarish life.

Her husband had already broken this man, and Vyriana wasn't particularly interested in dealing with her husband's leftovers. She felt like she was a child who had everything arranged for her just so she could feel good about herself, and as a warrior who always
carved her own way, she didn't like this feeling.
Nux, who saw his wife's expression, just smiled.
He could tell what his lovely Dragon was thinking, and for her, he only had one piece of
advice.
"Don't underestimate him."
"Huh?"
The moment she heard those words, Vyriana frowned. She turned towards Nux, but
suddenly, she felt something moving towards her.
Her body moved on its own, and she dodged the incoming arrow. The arrow, however, suddenly changed direction and moved towards her, catching her off guard.
And then,
BOOOOM
It exploded.
Vyriana's body was sent flying.
It was the same attack that had obliterated her arms before.
Yes, Zyros wasn't planning on holding back.
He may look like he was a broken being who had lost everything in his life. This, however,
was a chance for him to end his life and his misery.
He wasn't going to give up on it.
Rather, he was going to fight for it as desperately as he could, and seeing this sight,
instead of getting angry, Nux's smile widened.
After all, he knew this was exactly what his Dragon wanted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1807 I guess it is over, eh?
paragraphs: Whoosh

Before Vyriana could even fall to the ground, another arrow was shot, already prepared to hit her. Noticing that, Vyriana kicked in the air to change her direction mid-air, but the arrow once again changed its trajectory and moved towards her.
BOOOOM
Another explosion was heard. This time, however, Vyriana wasn't taken by surprise. Even though she was attacked, when the smoke and dust from the explosion cleared up, a
silhouette was seen.
It was Vyriana.

Her palm, which had grabbed the arrow at the last moment, had disintegrated, and there were burnt marks all over her arm and body. She, however, had a wide grin on her face as she stared at Zyros, her eyes shimmering with excitement.
"The same attack wouldn't work again, but you knew that already, didn't you?"
Vyriana's loud and delightful voice echoed throughout the battlefield.
Zyros stared at the madwoman in front of him and was taken aback.
To think that, instead of screaming or at least frowning in pain from having her hand disintegrated by the explosion, she was laughing instead.
It was a sight that reminded him of something...
That monster who was walking towards him with a wide grin when one of his eyes was disintegrated and the flesh on his face was burnt.
Zyros stared at Nux, his body trembling when he saw the grin on his face as he was staring at his wife.
Just what kind of couple is this...?"
He couldn't help but question.
He, however, wasn't given too much time to think,
He could sense that the woman was staring at him with a merciless smile on her face. Her hand had already grown back.
Yes, his energy no longer stopped her from regenerating.
The woman had broken through and was now a Primordial.
Zyros's Bow hummed with energy,
"That wasn't the best you had, was it?"
Vyriana questioned with a smirk.
Again, Zyros didn't reply. With a flick of his hand, he drew his bow back and shot an
arrow.
Whoosh
His arrow then hummed with energy and suddenly,
Whoosh Whoosh Whoosh
Thousands of arrows appeared around the main arrow, all rushing towards Vyriana at the same time, targeting every part of her body.
Nux, who saw this, raised his eyebrow,
'He didn't use this skill against me.'
Soon, however, he lost his interest. He could tell that this skill wasn't as powerful as he had expected.
Before these arrows could even reach Vyriana, they paused mid-air.
Just one look from Vyriana was enough to stop these arrows.

This was the manifestation of her physical strength. The ability to control reality using her physical might alone. It was somewhat similar to how Nux was using his 'will' to affect his surroundings; Vyriana's version, however, was tamer and more controlled. In the end, all the arrows that had frozen in the air were crushed into pieces.
Zyros, however, wasn't surprised that his attack was blocked. Rather, it felt like he was already expecting it.
Using Voidstep, he teleported to different points and shot around 15 arrows, all coming at Vyriana from different directions, and it wasn't a normal attack either.
It was Piercing Reality.

An attack that, if connected successfully, would end this battle right here and now. Not just that, Zyros had shot his arrows in such a way that even if Vyriana tried to dodge the attack, the other arrows coming from different directions would still hit her.
It was an attack that couldn't be dodged. Neither blocking it was possible, since if it as much as touched Vyriana's limbs, her powers would be sealed.
Well, at least that is what should have happened,
Vyriana, however, just punched.
BOOOOM
The energy from her punch burst out. Her Dragon's might, combined with her Absolute Strength, overpowered all the arrows that were aimed at her.
The arrows that could pierce reality wobbled and fell to the ground powerlessly, disappearing into nothingness.
Seeing this sight, Nux shook his head in disappointment.
'She is too strong. He isn't a match."

Nux knew what sort of monster Vyriana was. He had trained with this madwoman for thousands of years, and he was familiar with her battle style. Because of that, Nux knew that the Dragon was barely trying right now.

Zyros was trying. He was using everything he had in his arsenal, but in the end, Zyros was mercenary. He was strong because his allies filled in his weak points. Right now, however, against a monster like Vyriana, who was used to fighting alone and had next to no weaknesses he could exploit,
He was helpless.
Not to mention Vyriana was a Primordial Dragon that belonged to a High-Level World
and had an Absolute Law,
Be it the Bloodline or the Law,
Zyros was outclassed in every possible way.
And honestly, Nux wasn't the only one who realized it.
Zyros could see it as well.
However, there was nothing he could do but fight and fight desperately. After all, he
wanted to dic.
"Tsk, can't believe I was injured by something like you."
Vyriana snorted, clearly disappointed in herself.
She honestly wanted to use this battle to test her strength, but seeing the disparity in
their strength, she could tell that her plan wouldn't work.
"Whatever."
In the end, the woman snorted, and then,
She moved.
Zyros tried to retreat.
Using Voidstep to try and teleport again, but the Dragon had already appeared right in
front of him, not giving him a chance to escape.
All it took was a single step to cover the distance between the two of them. Her speed
defied all logic.
Honestly, the current Vyriana was extremely similar to Nux, the only difference was that, unlike Nux, she had perfect control over her body.

Yes, she was an even more monstrous existence for someone like Zyros. Before Zyros could react, her fist moved. It wasn't like he couldn't see the attack. Actually, to his enhanced senses, the punch could even be considered slow. However, his body wasn't as fast as his senses, and he couldn't stop it.
BOOOOOOOM
The punch connected with Zyros's chest, and he was sent flying.
His core shattered into countless pieces, the light inside it flickering violently.
"Khawwrkkk!!"
The Etheryn coughed, his entire body trembling from the impact. Once again, his body, that had just started glowing with a radiant blue hue, turned into a hollow, lifeless shell.
The Etheryn wanted to give up. He knew resistance was futile, but then,
"I guess it is over, eh?"
He heard Nux's playful voice. Using all his power to turn his head, he saw Nux walking
towards him, and in an instant, his body trembled.
No...
He couldn't give up.
He couldn't return to that hell again!
With sheer willpower, the Etheryn stood up, his body still trembling nonstop, his eyes,
however, were full of determination.
He saw Vyriana rushing towards him, and as his last-ditch effort, he used his trump card.
Astral Anchoring.

chapters.title: Chapter 1808 Thank you...
paragraphs: Astral Anchoring.
An ability that anchors his body to the fabric of space, making him immune to being physically displaced or destroyed by any force.

A perfect ability against beings like Vyriana. An ability that was countered with Soul Severance, however, since his opponent this time was not Nux but this woman instead, Zyros could rely on this ability.
...or that is what he thought.

Vyriana, however, knew what this ability was. Before the fight, Nux had warned her about Astral Anchoring and Piercing Reality. After all, these two were genuinely dangerous abilities. Honestly, Nux would have devoured Zyros into his Universe to steal these abilities if it weren't for the fact that Zyros had encountered his wives and the Universe knew that.
If Zyros disappeared in an unnatural way, it would put his wives in danger, and that was not something Nux could allow
"You have some interesting abilities."
Vyriana spoke as she started walking toward Zyros.
Zyros narrowed his eyes. He didn't know what this woman was planning. Vyriana, on the other hand, smiled.
"But what is your plan here?"
She questioned.
Zyros was still silent.
Vyriana brought her face close to this man and,
"How long do you think your energy would last?"
Yes, as a Primordial, Zyros's energy reserves were large, but... Vyriana was the same. She was now a Primordial as well.

Yes, Astral Anchoring was an extremely strong ability, but it was a defensive ability, Zyros needed something or someone to attack his opponents while he used this ability to protect himself, but right now, he was alone.

The Dragon could simply stand in front of him and wait for him to run out of energy. He might be 'untouchable' right now, but it wouldn't matter once he ran out of energy, and Zyros knew that. Therefore, he tried to attack. He tried to pull the string of his bow, but suddenly,
Vyriana grabbed his hand.
The archer tried to use force to free his arm, but he was helpless. When it came to
physical might, Vyriana was even stronger than Vrakor.

After all, just like Titans, Dragons were known for their strength as well, not to mention Vyriana was a Dragon from a High-Level World. Combined with her Law, Nux highly doubted there were Primordial Titans out there stronger than Vyriana in terms of raw power.
Zyros, an Etheryn, simply stood no chance.
"Do you see the problem now?"
Vyriana questioned.
"It is a one-on-one battle,
Half of your abilities won't work against me."
"I-I w-will still s-survive for as long as I can..."
This was the first time Zyros had spoken. After all, even now, he still couldn't give up. "You will not."
Vyriana shook her head.
Then, she placed her hand on the Etheryn's head and started pulling.
"Your ability only works on 'push","
The Dragon suddenly muttered.
"If I 'push' force toward you, your ability would deflect it to your surroundings, but... If I 'pull' instead, your ability fails."
Zyros felt his neck being stretched. Soon, he realized what was happening to him, and his eyes widened in horror,
*Crack* *Crack*
He could hear it.
His ligaments and muscles that tied his spine together with the rest of the body were breaking apart. His entire body trembled. The force Vyriana used was simply too powerful.
She...
She was about to pull his head off.
He was scared...
He was about to die...
As he thought of that possibility,
A smile of relief appeared on his face.
"Thank you..."

He whispered, his voice extremely soft. Vyriana completely ignored those words and pulled his head off. Blood splurged out of his torso like a fountain. Vyriana used her ability to block the blood from falling on her as she threw Zyros's head away with a bored look on her face and started walking towards Nux.
"You killed him."
Nux commented.
"You wanted to torture him more?"
"Meh, broken toys aren't fun."
Nux shrugged.

He could have used the man for some experiments, but he was honestly a bit too busy for all that. Not to mention his Vyriana was fine now, so he had calmed down. Even if she had kept him alive, he probably would have left him for Vyriana to deal with.
Zyros's death didn't matter to the couple.
"You will find stronger opponents soon, don't worry."
Nux comforted.
"What do you mean? I already have found a stronger opponent."
Vyriana's smile turned wilder as she stared at her husband. Seeing the familiar look on
her face, Nux's smile widened as well.
"I am guessing you will be joining the two of us as well?"
He questioned.
"I heard quite a few things happened. I need to hear the details."
Vyriana chuckled.
"Hahaha-"
Nux laughed out loud.
"I am sure others have surrounded her already." He spoke.
"I guess I need to go save my friend, huh. She too innocent to deal with those perverts
alone."
As she said those words, Nux just stared at her in silence.
There were too many things he wanted to say, but he knew it was wiser to stay silent. Especially if this madwoman was joining his training as well.
He could already imagine the future nightmarish days when the two friends work together and 'train' him. He wasn't planning to do anything that would make the experience even worse for him.
Yes, Nux wasn't a masochist.
I think...
"Ahem."
Nux just coughed as he waved his hand to devour Zyros's body using the Devouring Mist. Once he was done, he teleported back to where others were together with Vyriana. As
the two appeared,
They were welcomed with a somewhat surprising sight.𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
Nux and Vyriana were expecting that by now, the women would have surrounded poor Aeliana and would be teasing her to the point that her face would be red like a tomato.

Actually, the two were even looking forward to seeing that scene but... Right now... instead of surrounding Aeliana, the wives, along with Progenitors and Aeliana, had surrounded what seemed like a battle stage, and in the middle of the stage
stood two extremely beautiful women.
Lyriana Frostwillow and Rune Leander.

chapters.title: Chapter 1809 Why don’t you try facing a different opponent?
paragraphs: 15 minutes ago, back in the dimension where Sylvara lived, Aeliana, who was surrounded by Nux's wives, lowered her head in embarrassment.
"So then you kissed him? How bold"
Allura spoke with a playful look on her face. Her purple eyes glimmered in excitement as she stared at the Vampire and,
"I didn't expect you to make the first move. I guess I underestimated you, eh?"
"See!? I told you guys!"
Edda shouted as she patted Acliana's shoulder,

"We finally have another brave one who has the guts to accept her 'other' side." The other women gulped when they heard those words. After all, they knew what this tanned pervert meant by 'other' side, and honestly, just imagining someone like Aeliana shimmering in pleasure while she is bound by ropes like a pervert in heat made them lose their minds.
The women quickly shook their heads, getting that sight out of their minds.
Aeliana, who noticed their strange actions, frowned.
She could see it; she was being overwhelmed by these women. If she didn't do anything, she would lose control over the situation, and as someone who desired control, Aeliana couldn't allow that.
Her eyes looked around, and soon, she glanced at Lyriana.
"Congratulations, you finally got what you wanted."
She nodded at her.

Lyriana's talent was well-known even in the Order. They even wanted to recruit her, but Lyriana decided to choose her kingdom. Anyways, as the leader of the Ancestral Order, Aeliana knew who this woman was.

Not to mention she had been keeping an eye on Nux and people around him for a while now. So even if she didn't know much about Lyriana at first, now, it was different. Because of this, Aeliana knew what the previous Elven Queen wanted the most.
Actually, another reason why Aeliana was keeping an eye on Lyriana was somewhat personal.

Lyriana's situation was somewhat similar to the Progenitors, just that, unlike Lyriana, who had a choice in the matter, the Progenitors walked on the path of uncertainty and took the wrong turn. Sure, they had Yrniel to help them, but in the end, Lyriana and the Progenitors wanted the same thing,
And that was to rebuild their foundation.
Something that, in theory, should be impossible but... Nux made it possible.
'If he can reform her foundation, then...'
Aeliana glanced at the Progenitors present here, and her eyes shined with hope.
She could finally help them.
She could finally do something for these people who had given her nothing but love. "Thank you, Lady Acliana."
Lyriana bowed her head and replied with her voice full of respect.
"How do you feel?"
Lyriana questioned.
"Powerful."
Lyriana answered honestly.
"Is that so..."
Aeliana smiled.
"What Law did you form?"
Aeliana questioned, and only now did the Progenitors notice something.
This Elf...
She had turned into a Complete Cultivator.
She...
She rebuilt her foundation!
And if what Aeliana said was correct, then...
She also formed a Law...
The Progenitors were taken aback. In an instant, the atmosphere of the space changed. Lyriana became the new focus of attention as all the Progenitors stared at her.
They wanted to know how...
Their eyes shined with greed.

Some of them were even thinking of confronting the elf and forcing the answers from her. However, they decided to hold back because Aeliana was here. Not to mention this woman was connected to that monster.
The Progenitors already knew what sort of madman that monster becomes when it comes to his women.
Heck, the monster killed five Primordials because they were targeting his women! The last thing the Progenitors wanted was to attract his ire.
Yes, they weren't scared of him right now, but they were definitely scared of his potential.
When the wives sensed that the Progenitors' attention was on Lyriana, their playful expressions changed. Even though Lyriana wasn't one of them right now, she was someone Nux valued.
So when he wasn't here, it was the wives' responsibility to protect her.
Just like that, the focus was shifted from Aeliana.
The Vampire smiled inwardly and stared at the Elf,
"If you aren't comfortable, you don't have to share. It is fine."
She nodded.
"I was just taken aback."
Lyriana shook her head. She had sensed the rising tension as well, but she trusted Aeliana. Why? Because she could feel Nux's emotions and knew he trusted her.
"My Law is the Law of Absolute Frostbound Liberation."
"An Absolute?"
Aeliana raised her eyebrow in surprise. She knew this woman was talented but...
'She shouldn't have the ability to form an Absolute Law.'
Yes, Aeliana knew that things related to Nux were absurd. The man was breaking the rules the very Universe had set up, something even her father couldn't do.
Raising the potential of the ones around him wasn't something new for him. Heck, his Law, the Law of Absolute Growth, is made for that....
But...
'If he had the way to help others form Absolute Laws...
All his wives would have one...'
Aeliana knew Nux would use his abilities in an instant if it benefited his wives in any way.
The very fact that his other wives didn't have an Absolute Law while Lyriana did made Aeliana believe that it wasn't something Nux did but Lyriana herself.
Which was quite surprising on its own.
"Yes."
Lyriana answered, not revealing too much.
Aeliana stared at her and chuckled,
"You must be looking forward to testing your strength, no?"
The Vampire could guess it since she was familiar with her personality.
"I am."
Lyriana nodded.
The Vampire then turned towards another woman and,𝓯𝙧𝙚𝒆𝙬𝙚𝒃𝙣𝙤𝒗𝓮𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
"Why don't you two go all out then?"
Rune frowned as the attention suddenly shifted to her.
"What?"
She questioned, her cat ears twitching.
"You have been trying to defeat Astaria, haven't you?
Why don't you try facing a different opponent?
It might prove helpful as you might learn something new,"
"Facing a new opponent, huh..."
Rune muttered, her eyes fixed on the previous Elven Queen.
The Queen stared back, her eyes glimmering in excitement as well.
The two were rearing to go.
Amaya, on the other hand, narrowed her eyes when she saw this scene.
"She manipulated them a little too easily.'
She would have stopped the fight since she didn't want the Progenitors to see their
abilities, but in the end, Nux considered these people his allies, so she allowed it. After all, even Amaya was looking forward to seeing how strong Lyriana had gotten.

chapters.title: Chapter 1810 My wife sees the future.
paragraphs: The battlefield had transformed into a frozen wasteland, where Ice ruled as an Absolute. Every other element was severely suppressed, and entities that relied on these elements were helpless. It was as if the overwhelming cold drained their strength. Even Mana itself struggled to exist here.
The ground was covered in rough ice, sharp and treacherous, radiating a cold so intense that it felt like it would freeze the blood of anyone who stood on it for too long.

From a large boulder to the smallest sand particle, every little thing was frozen. Even normal wind currents had turned into dangerous knives because they carried tiny ice shards sharp enough to cut through skin and armor.
These shards weren't just sharp-they carried a freezing energy that could turn a perfectly functioning body into a solid ice structure from the inside out.

The very wind in this domain had become a deadly weapon, slicing through everything with icy fragments that stuck to flesh and froze it. Breathing the air felt as if one was inhaling a storm of needles, and taking even a single breath was like walking a step closer to death.
Solid spikes of crystalline ice erupted from the ground without warning, smashing or piercing through anything in their way. Even the sky above wasn't merciful; it was dark, heavy, and cold.
Cold lightning struck without mercy, freezing whatever it touched instantly.

Even movement became difficult in this domain. The freezing air seemed to slow everything down, making every action feel heavy and sluggish. Warmth was devoured instantly no fire, no magic, not even life force itself could last long in this relentless
cold.
This was not just a battlefield anymore-it was a trap.
A place where the chances of survival were next to none. Ice wasn't just a part of the environment here; it was alive, and it was out for blood.
Hunting and consuming everything in its path.
This was the Domain of the Law of Absolute Frostbound Liberation, the strongest ability of the previous Elven Queen, Lyriana Frostwillow.
An ability to render any being who stood against her.

Right now, however, the woman in question lay on the frozen ground, feeling the familiar coldness. Her body was filled with countless cuts and bruises. In her state, she didn't look like the overlord of this icy domain and the battlefield but like a defeated soldier who had surrendered to her opponent.
She was tired, she was hurt, and worst of all, she had given up.
Yes, Lyriana realized it.

As strong as she had gotten, against this woman, none of her abilities worked. Not matter how many ice spikes she summoned, no matter where she attacked her from, no matter how she tried to restrict her movements,
Nothing worked.
Rune was simply too strong.
At her current state, Lyriana knew she stood no chance.
"I give up..."
In the end, Lyriana had no choice but to give up.
Hearing those words, Rune, who had disappeared and was waiting for the chance to attack her again, appeared next to her and spoke in an emotionless tone.
"I thought you would continue the fight for a bit."
Despite her condescending words, Lyriana knew the woman didn't mean it in a bad way. She just said what was in her mind, and the previous Queen did the same.
"There is no point, I cannot win."
She shook her head as she grabbed the hand Rune had offered and stood up.
"You are still not used to your powers," Rune commented.
"I felt that."
Lyriana nodded.
"But I doubt I can defeat you even after I strengthen my control over my powers."
She wasn't optimistic, and the rest of the women who had fought Rune could relate to that feeling.
In a one-on-one battle, other than Astaria and Vyriana, no one else stood a chance against her.
Not even Amaya and Felberta.
One had to know, in theory, when compared, Lyriana, just like Felberta and Amaya, should be a lot stronger than Rune.
She had an Absolute Law.
She had a Primordial Elven Bloodline that Nux had gotten for her from the Progenitors, not to mention her Bloodline had upgraded to that of a High-Level
World.
She was better than Rune in every single aspect, but even then, she couldn't defeat Rune. Heck, even Astaria had a difficult time defeating the Cat woman.
Why?
Because Rune's Law was simply too absurd.
"Just... what are these monsters...?"
One of the Progenitors couldn't help but question.
"I... have no words..."
Another one replied.
"That Elf comprehended that absurdly strong Absolute Law and... she still lost...
How does that even make sense? It looked as if she threw the match. She was attacking when her opponent had already moved. None of her attacks hit."
"Well, of course."
Suddenly, a confident sound was heard.
"You think my wife will be defeated just because the opponent has an Absolute Law?"
It was Nux.
Rune, who heard those words, didn't show any reaction. Nux, however, could see her
tail waving left and right.
'Adorable-'

He muttered inwardly as he walked towards his cat and held her from behind. Of course, just like everything else, Rune saw this coming as well, but she didn't react. Nux's speed, even when he just walked, was fast. Not many of his wives could dodge him at their current level, Rune, however, was different.
Sure, like her sisters, she wasn't fast enough to react to Nux's speed, but...
She had extra time on her hands.
After all, the woman could predict what was going to happen and prepare accordingly.
If she wanted, she could easily avoid getting 'captured' by Nux but...
She didn't move.
Why would she?
It was her Nux.
It was the man she loved the most in this entire Universe.
If it was her Nux, he could do whatever he wanted to her.
Rune's body trembled as Nux's hand touched her abdomen. Her face was still neutral,
but her waving tail and twitching ears gave her emotions away.
"My wife sees the future."
Nux spoke, his voice couldn't be prouder.

It was as if the overwhelming cold drained their strength.
Even Mana itself struggled to exist here.
The ground was covered in rough ice, sharp and treacherous, radiating a cold so intense that it felt like it would freeze the blood of anyone who stood on it for too long.
From a large boulder to the smallest sand particle, every little thing was frozen.
Even normal wind currents had turned into dangerous knives because they carried tiny ice shards sharp enough to cut through skin and armor.
These shards weren't just sharp-they carried a freezing energy that could turn a perfectly functioning body into a solid ice structure from the inside out.
The very wind in this domain had become a deadly weapon, slicing through everything with icy fragments that stuck to flesh and froze it.
Breathing the air felt as if one was inhaling a storm of needles, and taking even a single breath was like walking a step closer to death.
Solid spikes of crystalline ice erupted from the ground without warning, smashing or piercing through anything in their way.
Even the sky above wasn't merciful; it was dark, heavy, and cold.
Cold lightning struck without mercy, freezing whatever it touched instantly.
Even movement became difficult in this domain.
The freezing air seemed to slow everything down, making every action feel heavy and sluggish.
Warmth was devoured instantly no fire, no magic, not even life force itself could last long in this relentless
cold.
This was not just a battlefield anymore-it was a trap.
A place where the chances of survival were next to none.
Ice wasn't just a part of the environment here; it was alive, and it was out for blood.
Hunting and consuming everything in its path.
This was the Domain of the Law of Absolute Frostbound Liberation, the strongest ability of the previous Elven Queen, Lyriana Frostwillow.
An ability to render any being who stood against her.
Right now, however, the woman in question lay on the frozen ground, feeling the familiar coldness.
Her body was filled with countless cuts and bruises.
In her state, she didn't look like the overlord of this icy domain and the battlefield but like a defeated soldier who had surrendered to her opponent.
She was tired, she was hurt, and worst of all, she had given up.
Yes, Lyriana realized it.
As strong as she had gotten, against this woman, none of her abilities worked.
Not matter how many ice spikes she summoned, no matter where she attacked her from, no matter how she tried to restrict her movements,
Nothing worked.
Rune was simply too strong.
At her current state, Lyriana knew she stood no chance.
"I give up..."
In the end, Lyriana had no choice but to give up.
Hearing those words, Rune, who had disappeared and was waiting for the chance to attack her again, appeared next to her and spoke in an emotionless tone.
"I thought you would continue the fight for a bit."
Despite her condescending words, Lyriana knew the woman didn't mean it in a bad way.
She just said what was in her mind, and the previous Queen did the same.
"There is no point, I cannot win."
She shook her head as she grabbed the hand Rune had offered and stood up.
"You are still not used to your powers," Rune commented.
"I felt that."
Lyriana nodded.
"But I doubt I can defeat you even after I strengthen my control over my powers."
She wasn't optimistic, and the rest of the women who had fought Rune could relate to that feeling.
In a one-on-one battle, other than Astaria and Vyriana, no one else stood a chance against her.
Not even Amaya and Felberta.
One had to know, in theory, when compared, Lyriana, just like Felberta and Amaya, should be a lot stronger than Rune.
She had an Absolute Law.
She had a Primordial Elven Bloodline that Nux had gotten for her from the Progenitors, not to mention her Bloodline had upgraded to that of a High-Level
World.
She was better than Rune in every single aspect, but even then, she couldn't defeat Rune.
Heck, even Astaria had a difficult time defeating the Cat woman.
Why?
Because Rune's Law was simply too absurd.
"Just... what are these monsters...?"
One of the Progenitors couldn't help but question.
"I... have no words..."
Another one replied.
"That Elf comprehended that absurdly strong Absolute Law and... she still lost...
How does that even make sense?
It looked as if she threw the match.
She was attacking when her opponent had already moved.
None of her attacks hit."
"Well, of course."
Suddenly, a confident sound was heard.
"You think my wife will be defeated just because the opponent has an Absolute Law?"
It was Nux.
Rune, who heard those words, didn't show any reaction.
Nux, however, could see her
tail waving left and right.
'Adorable-'
He muttered inwardly as he walked towards his cat and held her from behind.
Of course, just like everything else, Rune saw this coming as well, but she didn't react.
Nux's speed, even when he just walked, was fast.
Not many of his wives could dodge him at their current level, Rune, however, was different.
Sure, like her sisters, she wasn't fast enough to react to Nux's speed, but...
She had extra time on her hands.
After all, the woman could predict what was going to happen and prepare accordingly.
If she wanted, she could easily avoid getting 'captured' by Nux but...
She didn't move.
Why would she?
It was her Nux.
It was the man she loved the most in this entire Universe.
If it was her Nux, he could do whatever he wanted to her.
Rune's body trembled as Nux's hand touched her abdomen.
Her face was still neutral,
but her waving tail and twitching ears gave her emotions away.
"My wife sees the future."
Nux spoke, his voice couldn't be prouder.
